scripts.text:
[Devil Square Guardian]
This is the entrance to ^FF0000Devil Square^000000.
If you fail or die, the door will close and you must wait until the event starts again to re-enter.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔广场守卫]
这里是^FF0000恶魔广场^000000的入口。
如果失败或死亡，大门将会关闭，你必须等待活动重新开始才能再次进入。
进入。
资讯。
取消。

scripts.text:
[Devil Square Guardian]
Devil Square is now closed.
It will open at these times:
00:00 , 02:00 , 04:00 , 06:00
08:00 , 10:00 , 12:00 , 14:00
16:00 , 18:00 , 20:00 , 22:00

[Devil Square Guardian]
You do not meet the requirements to enter Devil Square.
 
Requirements:
 - Base Level 70
 - Registration fee 20,000z
scripts.translation:
[恶魔广场守卫]
你不符合进入恶魔广场的要求。
 
要求：
 - 基本等级 70
 - 报名费 20,000z

scripts.text:
[Devil Square Guardian]
Inside, you will encounter 3 waves of monsters. The monsters will grow stronger with each wave.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔广场守卫]
在里面，你会遇到3波魔物。每波魔物都会变得更强。

scripts.text:
[Devil Square Guardian]
If you defeat all the enemies, you will be given the opportunity to open 10 Treasure Chests with items, equipment, and rare cards inside!
scripts.translation:
[恶魔广场守卫]
如果你击败所有敌人，你将有机会打开10个宝物箱子，里面有物品、装备和稀有卡片！
[恶魔广场守卫]
